<definition>

Compare the problem itself, not the product area. A spike that is unstarted or in progress is not shipped.
Fail if a completed story solves the same problem, or a roadmap item already covers it.

response.content: {"critique": "The problem is that users repeatedly click 'Document type' without a clear interface response, causing frustration and blocked progress. I checked the five most similar stories and roadmap pages: claim information display (4135, started but not completed), document classifier confidence threshold (4133, unstarted), policyholder milestone notifications (Notion roadmap page), reporting navigation (4137, unstarted), and task overview (Notion roadmap page). None of these address unresponsive UI feedback on the 'Document type' control; they cover claims overview, classifier thresholds, notifications, navigation shortcuts, and task dashboards, respectively. No completed story or roadmap item solves this problem.", "verdict": "pass"}
